explainer_content.short_definition: 2010s and streaming-era rap, from trap's 808 grammar to prestige rap albums and melodic playlist dominance.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Modern rap absorbed southern trap production into the mainstream while streaming changed song length, release cadence, and the speed of influence.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It made hip-hop the central sound of contemporary pop culture and spread trap rhythm across global pop.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The low end, hi-hat motion, vocal processing, and playlist repeatability are often as important as traditional verse craft.
